comment: The mutant in reload is detected only by a test of another suite, through the limit that the test of reload leaves in the process. Every test is run for it: one process per mutant; --select-tests reach without --shared-process (a switch that one test evaluates is not narrowed); and --select-tests reach --shared-process, where it passes the suite that reaches it and is then run against every test (the default; without that run: expected-narrowed.json).
